carrier: 24 quotient-scar backbone relations and their five-type quotient

boundaries.derived: The path form has rank 18; adjoining the triangle contraction raises the rank to 23.
boundaries.open: QR-003 is the exact one-dimensional common radical of both native forms.
boundaries.reopen: Supply an independently typed norm, operator assignment, or detector channel for QR-003.

boundaries.derived: The five-type path matrix is integral, nondegenerate, and has inertia (3,2), hence (2,3) after overall sign.
boundaries.open: The overall physical sign convention and coordinate interpretation are not selected by path counting alone.
boundaries.reopen: Derive the sign and coordinate map from a physical action or response functional.

boundaries.derived: Triangle contraction is positive semidefinite; Hodge metrics are positive for a,b>0; the path metric is necessarily split.
boundaries.open: No source-native positive kinetic Hessian equals the split path form.
boundaries.reopen: Provide a stable action whose positive selector Hessian and split causal form arise as separately typed tensors on the same observables.

boundaries.derived: The type lattice has determinant 64, Smith factors (1,1,1,1,64), and a unique order-eight glue completion isometric to odd unimodular I_(3,2).
boundaries.open: This does not repair the full 24-dimensional lattice or identify a physical integral basis.
boundaries.reopen: Construct a functor carrying the five glued coordinates into the established primitive-two-form or link lattice.

boundaries.derived: The projected graph cycle code is [24,12,2], with weight-two words, and is neither self-orthogonal nor doubly even.
boundaries.open: No source-derived change of coordinates or metric upgrades it to the extended Golay code.
boundaries.reopen: Derive a different binary code from operator or detector data with dimension 12, minimum distance 8, self-duality, and double evenness.

boundaries.derived: The edge triangle cubic has rank 17 and radical 7; the type cubic has rank 4 and radical exactly the rules-out modality, also modulo three.
boundaries.open: It is not a nondegenerate Jordan cubic and has no continuous common stabilizer with either split metric.
boundaries.reopen: Supply a source-native cubic contribution involving the hard-boundary direction and verify a nondegenerate middle action and closure identity.

boundaries.derived: The Golay sewing tensor has trivial radical and M11 symmetry but no invariant symmetric metric; the relation cubic has radical one and a split metric.
boundaries.open: No invertible tensor intertwiner can preserve radical dimension.
boundaries.reopen: Exhibit a noninvertible quotient, extension, characteristic-zero lift, or symmetry-breaking functor and state which structure it intentionally does not preserve.

boundaries.derived: An existing sp(4)=so(2,3) action can act on any chosen real isometry to the established link carrier.
boundaries.open: The relation graph does not select the isometry or generate the Hamiltonian, kinetic term, amplitudes, or Schur blocks.
boundaries.reopen: Assign operator-valued arrows and prove that exact composition induces the transported generators.

boundaries.derived: The corpus distinguishes detector kernels and shows that detector channels contract Fisher information.
boundaries.open: No detector map measures the five relation coordinates, the index-eight glue direction, or QR-003.
boundaries.reopen: Specify observables and a calibrated response matrix with enough rank to distinguish the glued carrier and its hard wall.

boundaries.derived: The corpus has exact 27=3+24 counting, Jordan/Leech carrier analogies, and a five-dimensional split lattice bridge.
boundaries.open: There is no E6 action, exceptional determinant, E8 bracket, or Leech metric on the relation carrier.
boundaries.reopen: Give explicit products, brackets, invariant tensors, and representation identities rather than dimension correspondences.

verdict: The source-native pairing problem closes at a unique rank-five Spin(2,3)-type lattice and a 23+1 full-carrier boundary; physics begins at the missing operator, dynamical, translation, and detector functor.
